name: r2f-retrieval-v1-synthetic
description: Independent fixed diagnostic examples and paraphrase queries authored for this repository; not real repair records or an external benchmark.

corpus.title: One-shot iterator exhausted by second pass
corpus.text: Python generator is consumed by sum, count is zero; count during the single traversal.

corpus.title: Empty input division by zero
corpus.text: Explicit ValueError on empty sequence before calculating mean.

corpus.title: Mixed precision tensor dtype mismatch
corpus.text: matmul receives float16 activations and float32 weights; align dtype under autocast.

corpus.title: CUDA out of memory from retaining graphs
corpus.text: Loss tensors appended without detach retain autograd graph over steps; log scalar detached values.

corpus.title: DistributedDataParallel gradient hang
corpus.text: Ranks execute different branches and collective counts differ; ensure matching collective order.

corpus.title: data_loader worker deadlock
corpus.text: Forked workers inherit a locked mutex; use spawn context and avoid initialized GPU state.

corpus.title: Nonreproducible training across random seeds
corpus.text: Seed Python numpy torch and deterministic data sampler; record hardware and nondeterministic ops.

corpus.title: NaN loss with logarithm of zero
corpus.text: Clamp domain or use stable logsumexp when probabilities underflow.

corpus.title: Attention mask padding leakage
corpus.text: Mask padding keys before softmax and exclude padded labels from loss.

corpus.title: Data leakage across train test groups
corpus.text: Group-aware partition prevents identical patient or document groups in training and evaluation.

corpus.title: Stale cache key misses model revision
corpus.text: Include revision and configuration in cache identity and invalidate stale entries.

corpus.title: asyncio event loop blocked by sync IO
corpus.text: Blocking network client in coroutine prevents concurrent scheduling; offload blocking calls.

corpus.title: SQLite database is locked with concurrent writes
corpus.text: Keep write transactions short and use bounded busy timeout; serialize writers when necessary.

corpus.title: Unicode normalization mismatches filenames
corpus.text: Normalize composed and decomposed characters before lookup; retain original display name.

corpus.title: Duplicate JSON object keys silently overwrite
corpus.text: Strict object_pairs_hook rejects repeated keys rather than accepting last value.

corpus.title: Archive extraction path traversal
corpus.text: Reject absolute paths and parent traversal before writing into target directory.

corpus.title: HTTP retry duplicates non-idempotent writes
corpus.text: Use an idempotency key and retry only eligible failures with bounded backoff.

corpus.title: Timezone DST naive datetime ambiguity
corpus.text: Use aware datetimes and distinguish repeated local time with fold.

corpus.title: Floating-point cancellation in variance
corpus.text: Stable online variance algorithm avoids subtracting near-equal large squares.

corpus.title: Broadcasting silently changes tensor shape
corpus.text: Assert intended dimensions before subtraction; unintended singleton expands matrix.

corpus.title: Python list accumulation uses unbounded RAM
corpus.text: Stream batches instead of materializing all rows; retain fixed-size aggregate state.

corpus.title: Learning rate warmup scheduler off by one
corpus.text: Advance scheduler after optimizer update; account for gradient accumulation.

corpus.title: Gradient accumulation loss scaling incorrect
corpus.text: Divide by effective accumulation count and handle last partial batch.

corpus.title: Tokenizer revision changes special token IDs
corpus.text: Pin tokenizer and model revisions and check special IDs before inference.

corpus.title: Accuracy metric averages unequal batches
corpus.text: Accumulate correct predictions and sample counts rather than mean batch accuracy.

corpus.title: Connection pool exhaustion due to unclosed response
corpus.text: Close response context and return connections; bound pool and request deadlines.

corpus.title: Subprocess pipe deadlock on full stderr
corpus.text: Drain stdout and stderr concurrently with communicate and enforce timeout.

corpus.title: Race condition in shared counter update
corpus.text: Read modify write is not atomic; protect shared update with a lock.

corpus.title: UTF-8 decode error reading byte stream
corpus.text: Use correct encoding and incremental decoder for split multibyte sequences.

corpus.title: Windows path case alias collision
corpus.text: Detect case-insensitive duplicate paths and reserved device names before writing.

corpus.title: Noncontiguous tensor view reshape error
corpus.text: Transposed tensor has incompatible strides; reshape or contiguous copy as appropriate.

corpus.title: Checkpoint load misses module prefix
corpus.text: Normalize DataParallel module prefix only after validating expected key names.

corpus.title: Integer floor division changes negative values
corpus.text: Distinguish truncate toward zero from floor for signed integers.

corpus.title: Pagination drops rows with equal sort keys
corpus.text: Use stable compound cursor including unique ID; compare tuples consistently.

corpus.title: CSS flex child overflows with intrinsic min width
corpus.text: Set min-width zero where flex child must shrink; handle long unbroken text.

corpus.title: Git rebase conflicts from dirty working tree
corpus.text: Preserve uncommitted edits and apply reviewed changes in isolated branch.

corpus.title: 多线程互斥锁顺序不一致导致死锁
corpus.text: 统一加锁顺序并缩小临界区，避免循环等待。

corpus.title: 混合精度梯度溢出
corpus.text: 检测非有限梯度，动态调整损失缩放并跳过异常更新。

corpus.title: 缓存键遗漏输入参数产生脏数据
corpus.text: 对参数与模型版本做稳定摘要，避免不同配置共用缓存。

corpus.title: 分布式网络超时连接反复重试
corpus.text: 设置有限重试、退避和连接超时，检查网络与进程存活。
